title: Japan
dek: Three and a half weeks chasing koyo from Kyushu to Hokkaido to Tohoku — Fukuoka's food scene, a real Hokkaido tour, and the Pokémon GO Wild Area weekend in Sendai.

cover.alt: Naruko Gorge in full autumn color — red, orange, and yellow foliage lining the canyon walls

verified: Checked 29 Jul 2026 for the Oct 15–Nov 10 trip. Confirmed against primary sources: Pokémon GO Wild Area Sendai (Nov 6–8, 2026 — pokemongo.com), US visa-free entry (90 days), Japan Customs tax-free rules (¥5,000/store/day threshold; the refund-at-departure system replaces the instant discount from Nov 1, 2026 — this trip straddles that cutover), JR Kyushu rail-pass pricing, Yamato Ta-Q-Bin luggage forwarding, and every restaurant/shop/trail address in the Food & shopping, Gaming & anime, and Sights tabs. ⚠ Re-check before travel: the exact trip start date (Oct 15 vs Oct 22 — still being narrowed between the travelers), Wild Area Sendai's ticket sales and exact venue (unannounced as of this check), the Yukemuri autumn scenic-train's 2026 run dates (JR East Tohoku typically announces in Aug/Sept), the Zao Ropeway/Echo Line autumn closure date (historically early November — may already be closed by the Nov 5 visit below), JMC's first 2026 koyo forecast (publishes ~mid-September 2026 — every foliage date in this guide is a multi-year average, not a locked prediction), and the US State Department advisory level (its page blocked bot-protected fetches this pass — needs a live browser check).

entry.visa: Visa-free for tourism, stays up to 90 days. Japan's planned digital pre-arrival system ("JESTA") isn't targeted to launch until FY2028, so nothing new applies for this trip; the optional Visit Japan Web pre-registration remains optional, not mandatory.
entry.passportValidity: Japan's own rule only requires validity through your date of departure; the conventional 6-months-remaining buffer is still what most airlines check at boarding, so plan to that stricter standard.
entry.note: Assumes a US passport — on another passport, check your own country's requirement. mofa.go.jp blocked direct automated fetches in this research pass (bot-protection); this entry is corroborated via search-indexed content from the same official URL plus independent secondary agreement, not a live fetch — worth a quick manual re-check before booking.
